issues.title: Repo governance: ruleset, collaborators, environments, variables
issues.goal: Make `main` safe: protected branch, code-owner review, required checks, dev/prod environments, Actions variables.
acceptance: Ruleset `protect-main` active (PR + code-owner review + required checks + no force push)
`sush-kush` and `dggk78` have Write access
Environments `dev` and `prod` exist; `prod` requires reviewer and only `v*` tags
Secret scanning + push protection on
Evidence: screenshots in PR description

issues.title: AWS account bootstrap: budgets, MFA, state bucket, OIDC provider and roles
issues.goal: Do Parts 1-3 of the bootstrap guide.
acceptance: Free-tier plan type and expiry noted in project channel
$1 budget and zero-spend budget active
State bucket `wfa-tfstate-amit-cloudops-ap-south-1` with versioning and public access blocked
OIDC provider and roles `wfa-github-deploy-dev`, `wfa-github-deploy-prod` (and `wfa-github-plan`) exist with exact `sub` conditions
Actions variables `AWS_ROLE_ARN_DEV/PROD/PLAN` set

issues.title: Terraform skeleton for dev and prod
issues.goal: Create root configs, shared tags, and empty module skeletons so CI validates.
acceptance: `terraform fmt -check` and `validate` pass for dev and prod in CI
Backend uses S3 + `use_lockfile`, keys `dev/terraform.tfstate` and `prod/terraform.tfstate`
Default tags Project/Env/ManagedBy applied
Root outputs declared per the outputs contract (may be placeholders until modules land)
No resources yet beyond what is required

issues.title: Deploy workflow works end to end for dev (empty stack)
issues.goal: Prove OIDC + plan + apply from GitHub Actions to dev.
acceptance: Merge to main triggers deploy to dev using OIDC (no keys)
Plan and apply logs visible; prod path blocked unless tag `v*`
PR plan summary visible on a test PR touching infra
Screenshots/log links in PR

issues.title: Validate and finalise data model with fixtures and schemas
issues.goal: Turn doc 03 into machine-checkable JSON Schemas and tiny fixtures that tests can use.
acceptance: JSON Schema per table item (employees, leave_records, recruitment_events, analytics, attrition_risk)
Fixture with 12 employees covering root, orphan, terminated, new joiner, cycle (invalid) cases
Tests validate fixtures against schemas
No change to doc 03 (if a gap is found, open an issue, do not edit the contract)

issues.title: Mock API responses from the OpenAPI contract
issues.goal: Create `frontend/mock/*.json` for all six endpoints so the UI can be built before the API exists.
acceptance: One JSON file per endpoint, realistic values for 8 departments and 12 months
Contract test validates every mock against `docs/openapi.yaml` schemas
Org-tree mock has 3+ levels and at least one warning example

issues.title: UI design direction proposal (needs lead approval before building)
issues.goal: Propose 2-3 visual directions (palette, typography, layout, light/dark) for the dashboard. No production UI yet.
acceptance: Three directions with colours, fonts, layout sketch, chart styling
Accessibility notes (contrast, colour-blind-safe chart palette)
Lead picks one and records it in the doc; WFA-026+ do not start before this is approved

issues.title: Terraform module `data`: five DynamoDB tables
issues.goal: Create `employees`, `leave_records`, `recruitment_events`, `analytics` (with TTL on `ttl`), `attrition_risk` exactly as doc 03.
acceptance: Keys and types match doc 03
Provisioned capacity matches the budget table (23/23 total), no GSI, no PITR
TTL enabled on analytics `ttl`
Outputs: table names/ARNs for compute and api modules
`terraform plan` on dev shows only creates

issues.title: Deterministic seed script
issues.goal: `data/seed.py --env dev|prod` loads realistic dummy data into DynamoDB. Reference date 2026-11-27, seed 42.
acceptance: 80 active employees with department distribution from doc 03 + ~14 terminated in last 12 months
Hierarchy: 1 root, depth <= 6, no cycles, managers valid
Leave records never span months; performance scores 1-5 plausible
Recruitment: ~25 candidates/month for 12 months
Uses batch writes with exponential backoff; idempotent (second run changes nothing)
`--dry-run` prints counts and a dataset checksum; same checksum every run
Runs against moto in tests and against real dev tables

issues.title: Seed validation tests
issues.goal: Prove the seeded dataset satisfies every rule in doc 03.
acceptance: Asserts counts, department distribution, hierarchy integrity, no month-spanning leave
Asserts deterministic checksum equals a pinned value
Runs in `make verify` in under 30 s

issues.title: Aggregator: headcount, hires, departures
issues.goal: Pure functions + tests for monthly headcount/hires/departures per department and totals, last 12 months.
acceptance: Definitions exactly as doc 03
Edge cases tested: hire and termination in same month, termination at month end, first/last month
Returns `{metric_name: {month: value}}` structure used by the handler

issues.title: Aggregator: leave utilisation and 3-month average
issues.goal: Compute `leave_util_<dept>` and `leave_util_3mo_avg_<dept>` per doc 03.
acceptance: Formula exactly as doc 03 (2 days/month/employee, 1 decimal)
3-month average uses the 3 months before the month; handles months with <3 prior months
Zero-headcount department/month handled without division error

issues.title: Aggregator: recruitment funnel
issues.goal: Compute `funnel_*` cohort counts per month.
acceptance: Counts are cohort-based and monotonic non-increasing across stages
Months with no candidates return zeros for all five stages

issues.title: Attrition risk scoring module
issues.goal: Pure function implementing doc 04 exactly, with per-factor points.
acceptance: Weights 0.40/0.35/0.25, tenure lookup and bands exactly as doc 04
Worked example in doc 04 reproduced (87.5 High)
Boundary tests: 39.9/40.0, 64.9/65.0, tenure 5/6/11/12/23/24/35/36/59/60, new joiner proration
Decimal rounding half-up; deterministic ranking and tie-break

issues.title: Aggregator handler: orchestration, idempotent writes, EMF metrics, 12-month backfill
issues.goal: `handler.lambda_handler` reads source tables, calls metric modules, writes `analytics` and `attrition_risk` (PutItem overwrite), emits EMF metrics.
acceptance: Accepts `{}` and `{"as_of":"YYYY-MM-DD"}`
Writes every metric name in doc 03 for 12 months, plus risk rows and `risk_band_*`
Running twice yields identical tables (moto test)
Throttling handled with retries; fails loudly (exception) if write ultimately fails
Emits `EmployeesProcessed`, `MetricsWritten`, `AggregatorSuccess` via EMF; no PutMetricData calls
On success writes one `sys_aggregator_last_success` row (date = run timestamp, value = epoch seconds, ttl +7 days)

issues.title: Golden-file test
issues.goal: Pin aggregator output on seed data so accidental changes are caught.
acceptance: Test seeds moto with seed 42, runs aggregator with `as_of=2026-11-27`, compares to committed `expected_analytics.json` and `expected_risk.json`
README explains how to regenerate and when that is allowed
Intentional diff on a deliberate formula change is demonstrated in the PR

issues.title: Terraform module `compute`: aggregator Lambda + daily schedule
issues.goal: Deploy the aggregator with least-privilege IAM and EventBridge Scheduler (daily 01:00 IST).
acceptance: Function `wfa-<env>-aggregator`, python3.12, arm64, 512 MB, 120 s, zip from `build/aggregator.zip`
IAM exactly as doc 02 table
Log group retention 14 days
Schedule enabled; manual test invoke succeeds in dev
No wildcard resource ARNs

issues.title: Terraform module `auth`: Cognito
issues.goal: User pool, groups `HR_Admin` and `Leadership`, public app client (auth code + PKCE, no secret), hosted UI domain.
acceptance: Pool `wfa-<env>-users`, email sign-in, no self sign-up
Groups created; client callback/logout URLs use the CloudFront domain (and `http://localhost:8080` in dev only)
Domain prefix `wfa-<env>-amit-cloudops`
Outputs `cognito_user_pool_id`, `cognito_client_id`, `cognito_domain` per contract
Stays on Lite/Essentials tier

issues.title: Shared Lambda library: auth, responses, errors, CORS
issues.goal: `services/shared` used by every API Lambda.
acceptance: `require_group(event)` allows only `HR_Admin`/`Leadership`, returns 403 JSON error otherwise, 401 if claims missing
`ok(body)` and `error(code, msg, status)` produce the exact shapes from OpenAPI incl. CORS headers
Decimal-safe JSON serialisation
Fully unit-tested

issues.title: API Lambda: `api_metrics` (headcount, leave, funnel, system health)
issues.goal: Serve `/metrics/headcount`, `/metrics/leave`, `/metrics/funnel` and `/system/health` from the analytics table (health reads the `sys_*` rows written by WFA-025).
acceptance: Responses validate against OpenAPI schemas
Months ascending; arrays aligned; missing data yields zeros not errors
`months` and `month` query params validated (400 on bad input; add to OpenAPI only via lead)
`/system/health` returns series for the last 60 min and aggregator status (ok if last success < 26 h, stale otherwise, unknown if never)
Handler uses only `Query` on analytics

issues.title: API Lambda: `api_attrition` (top 10)
issues.goal: Serve `/attrition/top10` from `attrition_risk` and `analytics` distribution.
acceptance: Exactly 10 (or fewer if fewer active) sorted by score desc, tie-break employee_id asc
Each row has 3 factors with raw input and weighted points
Distribution counts match `risk_band_*`
Validates against OpenAPI

issues.title: API Lambda: `api_org` (recursive org tree)
issues.goal: Build nested tree from `manager_id` with recursion.
acceptance: Single root; children sorted by name
Cycle detected and broken with a warning; orphans attached to root with a warning; depth limit 15 with a warning
Only ACTIVE employees included
Validates against OpenAPI; tested with fixtures from WFA-005

issues.title: Terraform module `api`: HTTP API, JWT authorizer, routes
issues.goal: Wire the three API Lambdas and the health route to API Gateway with Cognito JWT authorizer.
acceptance: All 6 routes from OpenAPI exist, `GET` only, JWT authorizer on all
CORS allows only the CloudFront origin (plus localhost in dev)
Throttling burst 20 / rate 10; access logs retention 14 days
Lambda IAM per doc 02; output `api_url`
No-token request returns 401

issues.title: Contract test suite for all endpoints
issues.goal: One suite that exercises every API handler and validates against OpenAPI, including auth failures.
acceptance: Every route: 200 shape valid, 401 without claims, 403 without group
Suite fails if a route is added to OpenAPI without a test
Runs in `make verify`

issues.title: health_snapshot Lambda + 15-minute schedule
issues.goal: Every 15 min read last 60 min of API Gateway and Lambda metrics and store `sys_*` rows in `analytics` (served to the UI by `api_metrics`, see WFA-020).
acceptance: Writes `sys_api_requests`, `sys_api_5xx`, `sys_lambda_errors`, `sys_lambda_invocations` with TTL 7 days
Uses `GetMetricData` once per run (batched)
IAM: GetMetricData + PutItem on analytics only

issues.title: SPA shell: login (PKCE), tabs, config, API client
issues.goal: App shell with Cognito Hosted UI login, token handling, route guard, tab navigation, loading/error states, mock mode.
acceptance: Follows the approved design direction (WFA-007)
Loads `config.json`; `?mock=1` uses `frontend/mock`
PKCE auth-code flow, tokens kept in memory/sessionStorage, logout works
Denied screen for users without group
Chart.js and D3 from CDN pinned with SRI hashes

issues.title: Charts: headcount trend and leave utilisation
issues.goal: Grouped bar (hires vs departures) and horizontal bar (current vs 3-month avg).
acceptance: Department filter for headcount chart
Both charts keyboard/tooltips accessible, colour-blind-safe
Work in mock mode and live mode

issues.title: Charts: recruitment funnel and risk distribution
issues.goal: Funnel (horizontal stages with conversion %) and doughnut (low/medium/high).
acceptance: Funnel shows 5 ordered stages with counts and conversion
Doughnut uses thresholds from API response
Empty-state handling

issues.title: Attrition table with sortable columns and factor breakdown
issues.goal: Top-10 table; click headers to sort; expandable factor details.
acceptance: Sortable by rank, name, department, score, band (asc/desc, indicated visually)
Contributing factors visible per row (inputs and weighted points)
Band shown with text + colour (not colour only)
Keyboard accessible

issues.title: Org chart tab (D3)
issues.goal: Interactive tree in its own tab.
acceptance: Expand/collapse nodes, zoom/pan, search by name highlights and focuses node
Renders all ~80 active employees smoothly
Shows API warnings if present
Works in mock and live modes

issues.title: System health widget
issues.goal: Small panel showing API requests, 5xx, Lambda errors (last 60 min) and aggregator status.
acceptance: Sparkline or small chart + totals
Aggregator status badge (ok/stale/unknown) with last success time
Auto-refreshes every 60 s without piling up requests

issues.title: Terraform module `frontend`: private S3 + CloudFront (OAC)
issues.goal: Host the SPA securely over HTTPS.
acceptance: Bucket private with Block Public Access; only CloudFront OAC can read
HTTP redirects to HTTPS, TLS 1.2+, SPA fallback to index.html for 403/404
Response headers policy (HSTS, nosniff, frame deny, referrer policy, CSP allowing self, pinned CDNs, API and Cognito origins)
Outputs `frontend_bucket`, `cloudfront_distribution_id`, `cloudfront_domain`
Deploy workflow publishes `config.json` and syncs `frontend/`

issues.title: Accessibility and responsive pass
issues.goal: Make the dashboard usable on phone and keyboard.
acceptance: Usable at 360 px width; tables scroll inside containers
All interactive elements reachable by keyboard with visible focus
Contrast meets WCAG AA; no information by colour alone
Lighthouse accessibility score recorded in PR

issues.title: Terraform module `monitoring`: alarms, SNS, budgets visibility
issues.goal: Alarms for aggregator no-success 26 h, Lambda errors, API 5xx, with SNS email.
acceptance: Alarms exist per doc 02 SLO table; <= 10 alarms total
SNS topic `wfa-<env>-alerts`; output `sns_alert_topic_arn`
Runbook alert table verified against real alarm names

issues.title: Security hardening: tighten IAM, scan IaC
issues.goal: Replace AdministratorAccess deploy roles with scoped policies; add IaC scanning.
acceptance: Deploy roles scoped to `wfa-*` resources and required services only (documented policy)
Checkov (or tfsec) runs in CI; findings triaged with written justifications
No wildcard IAM actions/resources without justification
ADR recording the final role design

issues.title: Game day on dev
issues.goal: Break things on purpose and prove detection and recovery.
acceptance: Scenarios run: aggregator fails, API 5xx, expired/invalid token, DynamoDB throttling, bad deploy rollback
Each scenario: alarm fired (screenshot), time to detect, fix, runbook updated
Gaps turned into issues

issues.title: Smoke test script
issues.goal: `scripts/smoke.sh <env>` verifies a deployed environment end to end.
acceptance: Checks: SPA 200 over HTTPS, API 401 without token, 403 for no-group user, 200 on all 6 routes for HR_Admin user
Exits non-zero on first failure with clear message
Documented how to obtain test tokens (dev client only may enable USER_PASSWORD_AUTH; never prod)

issues.title: Production release v1.0.0
issues.goal: Tag, approve and deploy to prod; tick the Definition of Done.
acceptance: All DoD items ticked with evidence
Prod deployed from tag `v1.0.0` via approval
Cognito users + SNS subscription configured on prod
`terraform plan` on prod shows no drift after deploy
Budget shows $0

README has live demo link, 4+ screenshots, limitations statement from doc 04
Repo About/topics set
